subject: general
question:
Five persons P, Q, R, S and T have different salaries. The salary of S is more than the salary of only two persons. The salary of R is more than the salary of T. P's salary is more than Q's salary but less than T's salary.

How many people's salary is less than the salary of R?
solution:
As per the question,

Five persons P, Q, R, S and T have different salaries. 

 
• **The salary of S is more than the salary of only two persons. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3abd0665f97f07245d1dfdcccbe76d09c18e4baf2a6a4f648bf199c3773a18e9.png] -----(1)

 
• **The salary of R is more than the salary of T. **</li&g
